title: Outdoor Smoky Filipino Chicken Adobo
description: A one-pot Filipino dish featuring ground cumin and smoky flavors, wrapped in corn husks for a unique outdoor cooking experience. This high-protein-friendly adobo is perfect for a dinner gathering.
instructions: Start by preparing the corn husks by soaking them in water for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, ground cumin, smoked paprika, vinegar, soy sauce, black pepper, and salt.
Lay a corn husk flat and place about 1/2 cup of the chicken mixture in the center of the husk.
Fold the sides of the husk over the filling and roll up the husk to form a tight package.
Repeat with the remaining corn husks and chicken mixture.
Place the packages in a single layer in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 45 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the adobo hot, unwrapping the corn husks at the table.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
